qualification: read-only defining-source census; no runtime qualification

roles.payload:
{
        x: String,
        y: String,
        z: String,
        width: String,
        depth: String,
        height: String,
    }

name.description: The property name inside the property set; unique within the template.

kind.description: The value type every value of the property must have.

unit.description: Optional unit label printed beside the value (for example W/(m2.K)); length, area, volume and angle values are in SI units.

description.description: Optional help text of the property.

required.description: Whether every element the template applies to must have a value, own, inherited from its type or a default.

default_value.description: Optional value an element has while neither it nor its type states one.

allowed.description: The enumeration of allowed values; empty allows every value of the kind.

minimum.description: Optional lower bound of a numeric value.

maximum.description: Optional upper bound of a numeric value.

name.description: The name of the property set the template defines; unique among the templates.

applies_to.description: The element and type kinds whose elements should carry the property set; each kind at most once.

properties.description: The property definitions in display order; names unique.

code.description: The code inside the system; unique within it.

parent.description: The code of the parent row; absent for a root; the parents form a forest.

edition.description: The edition or version of the system.

source.description: Optional publisher or location of the system.

entries.description: The entry table, in display order; codes unique, every parent present.

storey.description: The storey plan the dimension is drawn on.

anchors.description: At least two anchors, in measuring order; each consecutive pair gives one segment.

angle.description: Direction in radians, counter-clockwise from the x axis, along which distances are measured.

offset.description: Signed distance in metres from the first anchor to the dimension line, positive to the left of the measuring direction.

lock.description: Optional check-only lock: the total length in metres the dimension must keep. It never moves anything; a diagnostic reports a violated lock.

offset.description: Offset in metres of the tag text from the reference point of the element.

rotation.description: Rotation of the text in radians, counter-clockwise.

offset.description: Offset in metres of the text from the anchor point.

text_height.description: Height of the text in metres of model space.

precision.description: Digits after the decimal point of a printed dimension value.

mark_size.description: Size in metres of the end marks of dimension lines and leaders.

gap.description: Gap in metres between an anchor and the start of its extension line.

overshoot.description: Length in metres by which an extension line passes the dimension line.

family.description: The family the parameter belongs to.

name.description: The parameter name: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit; formulas refer to it by this name.

value.description: The formula, in the canonical text of the expression language (for example `2 * width + 40 mm`); a literal is a formula without a parameter.

material.description: A formula of kind text: a material parameter or a quoted material id.

visible.description: A formula of kind boolean: the solid is shown while it holds.

offset.description: Where the origin of the solid lies in the family frame, as formulas of kind length.

number.description: The sheet number as printed on the drawing, unique within the project (for example A-101).

name.description: The sheet title as printed in the title block.

paper.description: The paper of the sheet: an ISO A size or a custom size in millimetres.

orientation.description: Landscape puts the long side of the paper along the width, portrait along the height.

project.description: The project line of the title block; empty prints the name of the project.

drawn_by.description: Who drew the sheet, as printed in the title block.

checked_by.description: Who checked the sheet, as printed in the title block.

date.description: The date of the sheet as year-month-day, as printed in the title block; empty prints none.

revision.description: The current revision mark, as printed in the title block; empty prints the mark of the last row of the revision table.

scale_label.description: The scale line of the title block (for example 1:100 or As indicated); empty prints the common scale of the viewports, or As indicated when they differ.

sheet.description: The sheet the viewport stands on.

view.description: The view the viewport shows: a plan, ceiling plan, section or elevation (a camera view draws nothing on paper).

position.description: Where the top left corner of the viewport window lies on the paper, in millimetres from the top left corner of the sheet, x to the right and y downward.

scale.description: Drawing scale denominator of the viewport: 100 draws the view at 1:100, from 1 to 1000.

crop.description: Optional crop rectangle in the drawing coordinates of the view (metres): the window shows only that part of the drawing; absent shows the whole drawing.

label.description: Optional title printed under the viewport; absent prints the name of the view.

sheet.description: The sheet whose revision table holds the row.

number.description: The revision mark (for example A, B or 1), unique within the sheet.

date.description: The date of the revision as year-month-day; empty prints none.

host.description: The wall the sweep runs along.

side.description: The face of the wall the sweep stands on, looking along the axis from start to end: the left (interior) or the right (exterior) face.

profile.description: Section of the sweep: the first coordinate runs out of the wall perpendicular to its face, the second runs up; the section is centred on its own origin, so a rectangle of width 0.02 and depth 0.12 is a baseboard 2 cm deep and 12 cm high.

height.description: Height in metres above the wall base of the lowest point of the profile.

inset.description: Distance in metres the profile is moved into the wall: zero stands the inner edge of the profile on the face, a positive inset embeds it, so only the rest shows.

side.description: Side of the host edge the railing stands on: for a stair or ramp the side of the direction of travel, for a slab edge left means inward and right outward.

edge.description: Index of the slab boundary edge (the edge from vertex `edge` to the next one); zero and unused for a stair or ramp.

inset.description: Distance in metres the railing path lies inside the edge of the host, towards the middle of a stair or ramp or towards the interior of a slab; zero stands on the edge.

cut_height.description: Plan view convention: height in metres above the storey elevation at which the plan cuts through the storey; absent means the default of 1.2 m.

start_join.description: Authored join preference of the end at the start of the axis; absent leaves the join to the geometry (auto).

end_join.description: Authored join preference of the end at the end of the axis; absent leaves the join to the geometry (auto).

base_slab.description: Optional slab the base of the wall stands on: the base follows the top surface of that slab (sloped slabs included) plus the base offset; absent means the base lies on the elevation of the storey plus the base offset.

u_grid.description: Grid rule along the wall: equal cells of about the spacing, or explicit lines in metres from the start of the axis.

v_grid.description: Grid rule up the wall: equal cells of about the spacing, or explicit lines in metres above the base.

interior_mullion.description: Section of the mullions on the interior grid lines: the first coordinate runs along the wall, the second through it.

border_mullion.description: Section of the mullions on the outer edges of the wall.

panel.description: The panel of every cell that has no override.

curtain.description: The curtain wall whose cell is overridden.

u.description: Zero-based index of the cell along the wall, from the start of the axis.

v.description: Zero-based index of the cell up the wall, from the base; a door panel belongs in row zero.

panel.description: What fills the cell instead of the default panel.

curtain_wall_type.description: The curtain wall type that carries the grid rules, mullion sections, default panel and materials.

u_grid.description: Optional grid rule along the wall that replaces the rule of the type; absent follows the type.

v_grid.description: Optional grid rule up the wall that replaces the rule of the type; absent follows the type.

tilt.description: Optional lean of the column: the top leans towards `direction` (radians, counter-clockwise from +x) by `angle` radians from the vertical, about the base point; absent is plumb. The cross-section perpendicular to the axis is the profile of the type, the ends are cut horizontally.

axis.description: The line or arc of the beam in plan, from its start to its end, exactly like the axis of a wall; a curved beam is an axis whose bulge is set.

top_offset.description: Signed vertical offset in metres of the top of the beam at the start of its axis from the top of its storey: positive lifts it above the storey top, negative hangs it below, zero is flush.

end_top_offset.description: Optional signed offset in metres of the top of the beam at the end of its axis from the top of its storey; absent means the same as at the start (a level beam), a different value inclines the beam, linearly along the axis.

offset.description: Distance in metres the top of the ceiling hangs below the top of its storey; the layers of the ceiling type stack downward from there. Zero lies against the underside of the floor above.

slope.description: Optional tilt of the ceiling plane: fall direction and angle; the top plane keeps its drop at the uphill edge of the boundary.

sill_override.description: Sill height in metres above the host base that replaces the sill of the window type; absent means the type sill for windows and zero for doors and voids.

reveal_depth.description: Optional depth in metres of the reveal on the front side of the opening: the distance from the front face of the host to the front plane of the window or door frame; absent centres the frame in the thickness of the host.

reveal_material.description: Optional material of the reveal surfaces (jambs, head and sill) between the front face of the host and the frame; absent leaves them in the material of the wall layers.

stringer.description: Stringer construction: kind, plus width and depth of each stringer in metres.

nosing.description: Overhang in metres of a tread beyond the riser below it; zero is flush.

tread_thickness.description: Vertical thickness in metres of each tread slab.

riser.description: Whether riser boards close the gap between treads.

landing_depth.description: Depth in metres of the landing of a turning flight, measured along the arriving flight.

baluster.description: Optional baluster row between the posts: section and spacing.

infill.description: Fill between the posts: none, glass or a panel with a thickness in metres.

host.description: Optional host (stair, ramp or slab edge): a hosted railing has no path of its own, its path and its base follow the host by inference.

path.description: Centre line of the ramp from its foot to its head: vertices with the bulge of the segment to the next one; the ramp climbs along it.

width.description: Clear width in metres across the centre line.

landing_start.description: Length in metres of the flat landing at the foot of the path.

landing_end.description: Length in metres of the flat landing at the head of the path.

landing_turn.description: Length in metres of the flat landing centred on every corner of the path where its direction changes.

max_slope.description: Largest allowed slope as the ratio of rise to run (for example 0.0833 for 1:12); the inferred slope is checked against it.

thickness.description: Vertical thickness in metres of the ramp slab, measured below its walking surface.

base_offset.description: Height in metres of the foot of the ramp above the elevation of its storey (negative below).

top.description: Constraint that resolves the height of the head of the ramp; the rise is the head minus the foot.

railing_left.description: Whether the ramp carries a railing along its left edge, seen in the direction of travel.

railing_right.description: Whether the ramp carries a railing along its right edge, seen in the direction of travel.

zone.description: The zone the space belongs to; absent means in no zone.

floor_finish.description: Material of the floor finish; absent means unfinished.

wall_finish.description: Material of the wall finish; absent means unfinished.

ceiling_finish.description: Material of the ceiling finish; absent means unfinished.

category.description: What the zone groups the spaces for (for example a fire compartment, a ventilation or a tenant zone).

occupancy_density.description: Persons per square metre of net floor area; the occupancy of the zone is the density times its net floor area.

usages.description: Space usages the scheme counts; empty counts every usage.

zones.description: Ids of the zones the scheme counts; empty counts every space, in a zone or not.

building.description: The building the view belongs to; a plan view's storey is one of its storeys.

storey.description: The storey a plan or ceiling plan cuts; absent for every other kind.

plane.description: The vertical plane of a section or elevation; absent for every other kind.

camera.description: The orbit camera of an orthographic or perspective view; absent for every other kind.

cut_height.description: Plan and ceiling plan only: height in metres above the storey elevation of the cut plane; absent means the storey's cut height for a plan and the ceiling convention of 2.1 m for a ceiling plan.

depth.description: How far the view looks, in metres: below the cut plane of a plan (above it for a ceiling plan), beyond the plane of a section or elevation.

crop.description: Optional crop rectangle in the view's drawing coordinates; absent draws everything.

hidden.description: The element categories the view does not draw, each at most once, in category order.

phase.description: Phase filter: when set, the view draws only elements of that phase; absent draws every phase.

scale.description: Drawing scale denominator: 100 draws the view at 1:100.

columns.description: The columns in display order; at least one.

sort.description: Sort keys in order of precedence; rows with equal keys keep the order of their element ids.

filter.description: Filters that must all hold for a row to stay.

group.description: Grouping levels, outermost first: rows are sorted by the group keys first and every group closes with a subtotal row.

itemize.description: True lists every element; false collapses each group (or, ungrouped, each set of rows that show the same cells) into one row.

storeys.description: Ids of the storeys the schedule covers; empty covers every storey.

phases.description: Phases the schedule covers; empty covers every phase. An element that carries no phase of its own counts as new, an opening takes the phase of its host.

fieldIdPolicy: Zero-based declaration order from native DslRecord; role IDs are census-derived and need derive macro confirmation before execution.
